title: [uuencoding-multi] Fix parse_subject yEnc filter ordering and trailing-dash trim
description: Skoll LOW-42 + LOW-43: (1) yenc_re().is_match() is applied to raw subject before strip_prefixes, inconsistent with other checks. Move yEnc check after prefix stripping. (2) base_subject trailing-dash trim applies unconditionally but should only apply when pattern 5 (dash-separated fraction) matched, to avoid corrupting filenames ending in dash.
close_reason: Moved yEnc check after strip_prefixes. Restricted trailing-dash trim to pattern 5 only. Added tests for both fixes.
